title: Protected bike network
summary: Builds physically separated bike lanes linking downtown, campus and the corridors.

decider.body: Chapel Hill Town Council, with NCDOT on state-maintained streets
how: Residents comment at public meetings and a Town Council hearing.
NCDOT reviews changes to the streets it maintains.

pros: Safer routes make cycling less stressful, so some short car and bus trips shift to bikes.
cons: Costs about $800,000 per km to build, paid off over years, plus upkeep.
Takes about three years to build out.
